svg.title: BalaurByte: penetration testing for whatever you build and run
svg.desc: An ASCII three-headed dragon made of hex bytes prints line by line. Each head locks on and keeps re-locking onto new kinds of target: web apps, apis, cloud, mobile apps, ai agents, networks, pos systems, mcp servers, kubernetes, source code, wallets, identity. The BalaurByte wordmark and an engagement profile type out: any system you can put in scope, validated findings, technical report and executive summary, retest after remediation, scope agreed before testing begins. A ticker lists system types already tested: multi-tenant saas, rest and graphql apis, ios and android apps, mcp servers, llm agents, corporate networks, crypto wallets, point-of-sale, healthcare platforms, kyc platforms, e-invoicing networks, payment flows.

g.text: PENETRATION TESTING FOR WHATEVER YOU BUILD AND RUN.
IF YOU CAN PUT IT IN SCOPE, WE TEST IT.
ANY SYSTEM YOU CAN PUT IN SCOPE
NDA AVAILABLE // REPORTS IN ENGLISH OR ROMANIAN
